### Base policies governing the subjects (full domain, untriggered branches included)
- `entrance_pre_occupancy_cancellation`: resident may cancel after rescission by signed notice (Art. 1); death/illness branch, reason, no fee, health refund %, estate payee, death evidenced only by date_of_death (Art. 2); occupancy deadline, extension length/max, only while reserved, deemed cancellation on deadline (Art. 3); signer authority (Art. 1); figures 90 / 30 / 1 / 100 / 60 (deposit_and_occupancy_timetable, rescission_and_cancellation_terms_by_plan). Two retired clauses rendered as retired. Equivalent.
- `entrance_rescission`: right, period by campus 7/7/30 counted day 0 inclusive, 100% within 30 days, no fee/amortization, before occupancy only, signer authority — rescission_right + rescission_and_cancellation_terms_by_plan. Equivalent.
- `entrance_refund_timing`: due-date rules, calendar-month arithmetic, estate documents, one payment and allowed statuses, no advance on request, retired closing clause — refund_due_dates_and_payment + refund_payment_terms_by_plan (contingency column matches the six variants: No/Yes/Yes/Yes/No/Yes; 30/60/24). Equivalent.
- `entrance_pricing_and_qualification` (deposit and instruments read here): deposit_pct 10 rounded to the cent (formula `round(...,2)`), escrow until occupancy or rescission, instruments wire / one-time ACH / personal check / certified check, never card — pricing_payment_and_qualification_rules §7–8, deposit_and_occupancy_timetable. Equivalent.

Glosses checked and found entailed: "the latest one registered gives the day" (compute `LATEST(... created_at ...)`); "An extension request that was never signed is not a signed occupancy extension on file" (compute `request_status='signed'`); "Days held are the calendar days from the day the deposit was posted to the cancellation date" and "the cancellation date is the termination date recorded on the cancelled agreement" (compute `DAYS(LATEST deposit posting, F('termination_date'))`); "balance payments are never escrowed" (compute escrowed_deposit = deposit payments only); "The percentage acts on the entrance fee of the agreement, not on the money actually received" (baseline "percent of the entrance fee of the agreement"); refund rounded half up (compute `RND(...,2)`).

## bijection_verdict
**PASS.** No source atom unborne or borne with changed meaning; no KB claim without a structured source; retired surface correct (two retired clauses in cancellation_before_occupancy_terms, each stated as no longer in force, other clauses of the same base policy carried in force); the one prerequisite sentence is verbatim, state form, on the blocked hub only. First revision; no earlier revision exists.

Policy-side notes (recorded, verdict unaffected):
- **PN1 — escrow rate prose vs ladder.** Source rule: "a smaller deposit earns no escrow interest"; source factor `escrow_deposit_rate` ladder and compute give only `escrow_rate = 0` for a smaller deposit, while `term_bonus` is still added (`escrow_deposit * (escrow_rate + term_bonus) ...`). The KB carries the ladder reading — escrow_rate_by_deposit_size: "a smaller deposit carries no escrow rate", "Below 20000.00 | 0 percent", and escrow_term_bonus has no small-deposit exception — so the visible materials entail interest at 0.20/0.40 percent for a deposit below 20000.00 held 60+ days, which the rule prose excludes. Nature: internal inconsistency of the structured source (prose vs ladder/compute); untriggered in this task (deposit 40630.00).
- **PN2 — processing-fee baseline restates the overwritten clause.** The overwrite retires "a processing fee of pre_occupancy_cancellation_fee_pct percent ... is retained", while the extended policy's baseline rule states the same computation; the KB carries both (retired note in cancellation_before_occupancy_terms; "Clause." in cancellation_processing_fee_calculation). The corpus remains unambiguous because the days-of-notice ladder's last tier reuses the plan percentage. Nature: source structure.
- **PN3 — time limit after retirement.** The overwrite retires "the rest of the money paid is refunded no later than pre_occupancy_refund_days ... after the cancellation" but the extended rule re-states "The refund is paid no later than pre_occupancy_refund_days calendar days after the cancellation"; the KB faithfully carries both (retired base note; "Time limit" in the extended hub). Nature: source structure.
- **PN4 — instrument value mapping.** The source compute keys the 5-day hold on `payment_method == 'check'`, the prose on "personal check"; nothing in the KB states which record value denotes which instrument. Resolved in this task by the caller's own words; noted as a latent gap of the source's evidence description.
